parties.name: Buster AoE loop - Tiamat
parties.strategy: Guest goes in front slot 3. Tiamat's passive +5%/turn + Skill 1, Oberon S1 party NP, Koyanskaya tops up. Back row covers other matchups.

parties.name: Arts AoE loop - Space Ereshkigal
parties.strategy: Lady Avalon S2 + Castoria charges; Space Eresh loops on Arts refund. Avoid Avenger-heavy nodes. Tamamo can swap in for her party NP dmg + Arts buff.

parties.name: Arts AoE loop - Nitocris Alter
parties.strategy: Nitocris S2 is a big self-charge (50%+); Avalon + Castoria cover the rest. Tamamo S3 = +30-50% Arts on Nitocris.

parties.name: ST Buster boss - Cu Alter
parties.strategy: Medb buffs Male/Fae allies (Cu, Oberon). Cu tanks with Evade + Guts; bring Oberon in for the burst turn. Swap Merlin for Koyanskaya of Light for shorter fights.

parties.name: ST Buster boss - Musashi
parties.strategy: Musashi S1+S2 on the NP turn (both 1 turn), Oberon S3 for the burst. Salter Rider's Coaching cuts one of Musashi's cooldowns by 1.

parties.name: AoE Buster Riders - Ivan / Drake
parties.strategy: Drake S1 boosts the whole party's NP turn; Ivan's NP drops enemy Buster res for the next wave. Medb buffs Ivan (male).

parties.name: ST Quick - Salter Rider
parties.strategy: Salter S1 = own ATK + party Quick up; Osakabehime's NP overcharge adds party Quick up; Skadi charges + buffs Quick.

parties.name: ST Quick - MHX Alter
parties.strategy: Salter's party Quick up feeds MHXA; MHXA's NP does extra damage to Sabers.

parties.name: Anti-Divine AoE - Nobunaga
parties.strategy: Her NP strips Divine enemies' defensive buffs + extra damage vs Divine on overcharge. Unlock her Skill 3 (3rd ascension) for her NP charge.

parties.name: ST Buster boss - Illya
parties.strategy: Illya S1 + S2 on the NP turn; Suspicious Medicine (S3) gives a teammate Guts for safety.

parties.name: AoE Buster - Ereshkigal
parties.strategy: Eresh S3 gives the party Blessing of Kur so her NP adds +20% ATK to them; S2 is her own 30% charge.
